scope: Scientific completion of Steffel 1791/1809 as the RHD reference implementation reusable for subsequent historical sources.
interpretation: Weighted project-completion measure, not linguistic accuracy and not a human-validation rate.

dimensions.label: Documentary coverage, segmentation and diplomatic transcription
dimensions.completion_gate: All candidate boundaries disposed and all active dictionary articles diplomatically transcribed.

dimensions.label: Independent human validation and critical layer
dimensions.note: 25% represents review infrastructure/readiness, not completed human adjudications; actual independent human-reviewed records remain 0/482 at this cut.
dimensions.completion_gate: Declared human-review universe adjudicated or explicitly retained unresolved, with critical readings represented non-destructively.

dimensions.label: Reusable RHD 1.0 architecture and provenance
dimensions.completion_gate: Canonical model, source profile boundary, provenance and tests implemented without destructive migration.

dimensions.label: TEI/TEI Lex-0/IIIF interoperability
dimensions.note: The strict Lex-0 projection validates in CI against the official TEI Lex-0 0.9.5 RNG. Remaining interoperability work is primarily real-facsimile IIIF publication and region-level linking.
dimensions.completion_gate: Strict Lex-0 projection validates against official release schema and real facsimile is exposed through stable IIIF-compatible identifiers/images.

dimensions.label: Diachronic and comparative research
dimensions.completion_gate: Priority relations receive appropriate human semantic/comparative adjudication; candidates and negative controls remain traceable.

dimensions.label: Numeration appendix and trilingual language sample
dimensions.note: OCR-level structure now exists for the numeration appendix, 22 formula blocks and the separate Lord's Prayer; facsimile collation and canonical/TEI integration remain pending.
dimensions.completion_gate: Appendices facsimile-collated diplomatically, structurally encoded and integrated into canonical/TEI projections.

dimensions.label: Scientific release, archive and citability
dimensions.completion_gate: Stable RHD 1.0 release, DOI/deposit/archive, integrity manifest and explicit conformity statement published.

dimensions.label: End-to-end replication on a second historical source
dimensions.completion_gate: A real second source is ingested end-to-end without fundamental redesign of the RHD core.
